LESSON: THE BATTLES OF BADR AND UHUD

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: History of Islam
Topic 7.1: The Battles of Badr and Uhud

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The Battles of Badr and Uhud
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What lessons can Muslims learn from the battles of Badr and Uhud?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the reasons that led to the battles of Badr and Uhud to appreciate Islamic heritage
2. explain the effects of the battles of Badr and Uhud to strengthen their Iman
3. appreciate reliance on Allah (S.W.T.) in overcoming challenges in day-to- day life
